name: Sakura Kouko
source:
A second-year high school student who has a kind personality and values her friends more than anything. Due to some past events her body developed a weird condition that makes her pass out at times.

To Kouko, her best friend [url=/c70332]Nanaka[/url] is an irreplaceable friend who has always supported and been on her side, so it's now her time to help her out...
